To make payments for real estate taxes & vehicle renewals by mail, online, or over the phone. Please call our office at 620-724-8222 or 620-724-4959 with any questions.
To pay by mail, send all tax payments & renewals to Crawford County Treasurer, PO Box 96, Girard, KS 66743
To pay real estate taxes or renew vehicle tags online, visit website
To pay by phone for real estate taxes over the phone, call 620-724-8222
To pay by phone to renew vehicle tags over the phone, call 620-724-4959
​
​ Here is a list of things you need to know before making a trip to our office. The Girard office is open to the public from 8:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. The Satellite office located inside the Judicial Center in Pittsburg is open 8:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M.
There will be drop boxes available inside the court house if you do not need to wait. If dropping a payment off make sure to include a way for us to contact you if we have any questions.
VIN Inspections are open at the Sheriff’s Department from 8:00 A.M. to 3:45 P.M. from Monday - Thursday and 8:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M. on Friday . Please make sure to have your title, driver’s license and $20.00 cash or check when you arrive and follow the signs. For more information visit the Crawford County Sheriff’s Office Facebook page or contact the office at 620-724-8274 .
Please contact our office at 620-724-8222 or 620-724-4959 with any questions or concerns. ​​

Mission Statement: To keep accurate accounting records for the county
To invest taxpayer's money with safety being the first concern, liquidity being the second, and the rate of return being the third.
Property Tax Payments
Pay Online Property Tax Payments
Look up Current and Previous Tax History
Kansas Vehicle Registration Online
Service and Responsibilities: The Treasurer's Office collects property tax on real estate, business, and other personal property, and distributes those taxes to the state and all other taxing units in the county (cities, schools districts, townships, etc.) for their use.
The Motor Vehicle Department is an agent for the State of Kansas for registering and titling motor vehicles and IRP's
The County Treasurer operates as "County Banker" for all county funds
The Treasurer's Office is a satellite location for renewing Kansas Drivers Licenses
